messages:
Ethan Morales: Heads-up 4 Aurelia Systems EBR booked for Thu 2026-04-09 09:00am PT. Need: single-slide health snapshot, renewal risk heatmap, training summary, and a short customer ask. Can someone take the risk heatmap and who will do the training recap? Suggested dry-run Wed 2026-04-08 10:00am PT.

Priya Kapoor: Ill take the training recap. Will include enablement sessions delivered, attendance, and outstanding enablement requests. Planning a 2-minute bulleted slide.

Leah Martinez: I'll do the health snapshot (activation, DAUs, error trends). Will call out onboarding completion % and open CS tickets. Note: one onboarding ticket flagged P1 for IAM mapping.

Aaron Blake: I can produce the renewal risk heatmap. Will mark risk level (green/amber/red) and add mitigation owners. Quick Q: do we include infra-utilization on the heatmap or separate? cc @Tom Yamaguchi for Dedicated utilization numbers.

Tom Yamaguchi: Include infra-utilization as a small column on the heatmap, yes. I'll add GPU-hours vs committed and a note on upcoming Dedicated maintenance window.

Rosa Diaz: I'll draft the customer ask slide and the 3-item follow-up list. Recommend: (1) training for infra team, (2) extended trial credits for burst, (3) technical deep-dive follow-up within 2 weeks.

Ethan Morales: Excellent. Please add slide drafts to the shared deck by Tue EOD so we can iterate. Deck link: https://docs.google.com/d/aurelia-ebr-collab. Label slides with your name and a readiness tag (ready/draft).

Leah Martinez: Quick note  APAC usage dropped last week after their internal infra change. Hypothesis: new CNI plugin caused traffic routing issue. Adding trend and a note to ops.

Priya Kapoor: Added enablement attendance table and action owners. Also attaching short playbook excerpt (will link in deck).

Aaron Blake: Heatmap draft uploaded. Marked two medium risks: usage volatility and IAM mapping. Proposed mitigations: weekly ops sync + targeted dev training.

Tom Yamaguchi: Uploaded utilization numbers. Two comments: committed GPU-hours are underutilized by 12% last billing cycle; also scheduled maintenance Apr 15-16 may impact throughput briefly.

Ethan Morales: Thanks. For the dry-run: plan = 5min executive summary (customer exec), 20min product & onboarding walkthrough, 10min risk discussion + ask, 15min Q&A. Please rehearse your slides for 3-4 minutes each.

Rosa Diaz: Also propose a 2-question live poll during the EBR: (1) priority area to invest in next quarter, (2) willingness to pilot Dedicated autoscale. I'll make a tiny Google Form and attach.

Leah Martinez: I'll include p50/p95 latency by route and a small table of recent errors. If Tom can add route-level capacity numbers that would be great.

Tom Yamaguchi: Added route capacity. Also will prepare a one-slide cost vs commit visualization for the billing readout.

Priya Kapoor: Heads-up  we still have one outstanding enablement request for their infra team (service account mapping). Who will own the fix? @Aaron Blake?

Aaron Blake: I can coordinate with infra on the mapping. Will set a target to close it before the EBR.

ops-bot: Staging deploy succeeded at 2026-04-03T14:22:10Z. All smoke tests passed. Reminder: include recent trace IDs in notes if demo'ing.

Leah Martinez: Planning a short live demo of the integration. Command I'll run: ```curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.example/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN' -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"integrations smoke"}]}'```

Tom Yamaguchi: If you're demoing, use trace id prefix aurelia-demo-20260403. I'll watch for any capacity spikes.

Ethan Morales: Dry-run invite out. Please mark conflicts asap. If anything blocks you from adding slides by Tue EOD call it out here. After dry-run I'll collate action items and owner list.

Rosa Diaz: Added the feedback form link to the deck (short form: top concern, training effectiveness, preferred follow-up cadence).

Priya Kapoor: Dry-run confirmed for Wed 10am PT. I'll have the training slide ready.

Aaron Blake: Heatmap owner note: I'll follow up with mitigation owners in a separate email and add expected close dates.

Leah Martinez: Done  health slide updated (marked DRAFT).

Ethan Morales: Great work team. We'll run the dry-run focused on flow and timing. Post EBR, we'll schedule a 1:1 with Aurelia execs for any red/amber items.

Tom Yamaguchi: All set from infra.

ops-bot: Calendar event created by Ethan Morales for Aurelia EBR dry-run 2026-04-08T17:00:00Z.

Ethan Morales: Closing loop  see you all at the dry-run. Add any last-minute notes here.
